    Steam Achievement Sets — Now Available to Everyone
    Today, the recent achievements update featuring Steam Achievement Sets and a new achievements page, is available to all Steam users. Achievement Sets are ideal for organizing achievements within a game, making it easier for players to track their progress and discover new achievements as games add them. They also allow games to add new achievements, or new DLC with achievements, without breaking prior game completion. You can read the full blog post here, but here's a quick summary... Track progress by achievement set - You can track progress across each achievement set in a game, each with their own progress bar and trophy. Keep game completion intact - If new achievements are added to a game, it won't break previously completed sets or take away your game completion. DLC achievements - Achievements can now be tied to DLC and can be organized into their own sets, with progress reflected separately from the base game. Complete games or sets with retired achievements - Developers can archive or retire achievements and sets when they're no longer available, preserving them for players who earned them without affecting future completion for everyone else. We've also revamped the achievements page to bring together overall game progress, individual set progress, achievement details, Global Stats, and expanded search and filtering. Enjoy competing with friends? Players can now compare their achievements progress with up to three friends, based on a more accurate total achievement count. Throughout the beta, we've continued to make improvements based on feedback from both players and developers, and we'll continue to do so. We'd like to thank everyone who participated and took the time to share their thoughts. Are you a game developer interested in seeing how easy it is to add achievement sets? Read the Steamworks blog post here.  ( 1 min )

    SteamOS 0.5.8 Beta for Steam Frame
    SteamOS 0.5.8 (for Steam Frame) has just been released. This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel. Camera Pass Through / Room View: PC Streaming now supports Room View. Previously, enabling Room View would hide remote content. You can now see remote desktop / remote game theater while camera passthrough is active. PC VR games with OpenXR mixed reality support are now able to blend VR content and camera passthrough. (Example: X-Plane 12) Note: this feature requires also opting into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC To opt into the beta branch of SteamVR on PC, right-click on SteamVR in your Steam library, select Properties, Game Versions & Beta, and choose beta. General Overlay render quality is now always set to Low on Steam Frame, and the option is hidden. This fixes problems that happened when Ultra was selected. Improved eye tracking self-calibration. Fixed low-end gamma response, including inconsistencies between eyes, on some headsets. Fixed a permission issue that prevented WebXR from working in Chrome v157. Developers: Allows OpenXR games streamed from PC to use [c]XR_ENVIRONMENT_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND[/c]. SteamVR has been updated to version 2.19.2.  ( 1 min )

General Overlay render quality is now always set to Low on Steam Frame, and the option is hidden. This fixes problems that happened when Ultra was selected. Improved eye tracking self-calibration. Fixed low-end gamma response, including inconsistencies between eyes, on some headsets. Fixed a permission issue that prevented WebXR from working in Chrome v157. Developers: Allows OpenXR games streamed from PC to use [c]XR_ENVIRONMENT_BLEND_MODE_ALPHA_BLEND[/c]. SteamVR has been updated to version 2.19.2.  ( 1 min )

    SteamOS 0.5.7 Beta for Steam Frame
    SteamOS 0.5.7 (for Steam Frame) has just been released. This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel. SteamVR: SteamVR has been updated to version 2.19.1 Improved vibration filtering for pose prediction that was affecting some units The display dims for 30 seconds before sleep Foveated sharpening is now independent from Eye Tracking (previously would disable when off, now defaults to centered) Removed Advanced Supersampling support on Steam Frame The guided tour keeps Steam docked front and center Frame Controllers: Battery now shows correctly at 0% Added default bindings for Chromalab, Batman Arkham, and Doom VFR OS: Enable support for WebXR in Chromium 157 & up Audio: Fixed an issue where audio would stop working with USB or Bluetooth speakers if an application tried to access the microphone Added controls to selectively disable echo cancellation and noise suppression for the microphone (requires current Steam Client Beta) You can opt into the Steam Client Beta on headset via Settings > System > Steam Client Update Channel.  ( 1 min )

    Steam Beta Client Update: October 15th
    We have just shipped an updated Steam Client to the Preview/Beta channel. Steam Achievement Sets A new way to organize, track, and complete a game's achievements. Read more details in the announcement. Games can now organize and group achievements for base game and DLC content DLC achievements can be added via sets without breaking game completion Completed achievement sets remain completed when new sets are added Achievements and sets can be archived if they are seasonal or can no longer be achieved Updated Achievements page and achievement rollup displays General Notifications settings layout has been changed to be easier to work with on all screen sizes Fixed multiple edge cases that could cause memory leaks in game streaming and controller code Multiple general stability improvements and fixes for rare crashes affecting small numbers of users Fixed an error displaying dates for users in British Columbia Library Improved offline support for the activity feed and fixed cases where it could previously skip loading some events. Linux The Steam client is now a 64bit application. The Steam client now runs inside a Steam Runtime container. This will help the Steam client provide a more consistent experience across multiple distributions. This is the same technology used by Steam games. Fixed a case where Steam updater UI would fail to show for some users. Remote Play Added a "Display Style" setting to allow stretching and zooming when the stream is a different aspect ratio than the client display. Steam Controller Firmware Fixed an issue where shutting down a controller while docked to the puck could cause it to turn back on Accessibility Background art will appear on the home screen when High Contrast is enabled  ( 1 min )

    Steam Client (for Steam Frame) has just been released for all users with the following changes: Steam Frame Improve reliability of pairing with the Steam Frame Wireless Adapter.     SteamOS 0.5.6 Beta for Steam Frame
    SteamOS 0.5.6 (for Steam Frame) has just been released. This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel. OS: Disable avahi-daemon publishing mDNS, causing polluting frame-XXXX.local mDNS mappings, and in some cases delaying shutdown. Allow .apk files in right-click "add to steam" context menu in Desktop mode. Improve performance overlay battery and memory usage reporting. Streaming: Improve robustness of connecting using the Steam Frame Wireless Adapter, making it able to connect in some situations it previously could not. Audio: Add echo cancellation and noise suppression for external microphones.  ( 1 min )
